It’s high time that more Republicans join us in holding Trump accountable, and stand up for their constituents and our Constitution.

This morning, the House of Representatives passed my War Powers Resolution to end Trump’s illegal war in Iran. 

Four Republicans put our country above party to join us on this vote. Now it’s time for the rest of them to grow a spine and stand up for the American people.

Congress cannot let Todd Blanche and this Department of Justice continue to do nothing about the administration’s illegal war.

We will do everything we can to keep up the pressure, whether that’s forcing more votes or taking this to the courts.

Those who refuse to stand up to their dictator in chief will have to answer to all their constituents who want this war to end.

Today, the House PASSED my bipartisan War Powers Resolution to end the war in Iran by a vote of 214-208.

This is a big victory for the vast majority of Americans who want President Trump to end this illegal war and focus on their lives right here at home.

This morning, the House must pass my War Powers Resolution and we must end this war immediately.
